newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end lower after fund injection.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end lower after fund injection.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates finished lower on Wednesday after the central bank on Tuesday injected T$4 billion in funds into the banking system, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate closed at 5.267 percent against Tuesday's 5.445 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.15-5.20 against 5.50. Dealers expected the rates to fall further as the banking s a positive T$33.6 billion.
The bond market was quiet ahead of Thursday's public holiday. The money and bond markets will be reopen on Friday.
